messages.subject: Re: changing the size of the axis text
parts:
Something like this will allow you to control position, angle and size of characters.

+
      opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(angle = 90,hjust = 1, size = 7.5,col="grey50"),
      axis.text.y = theme_text(hjust = 1, size = 7.5,col="grey50"),
      axis.title.x=theme_text(size=8),
      axis.title.y=theme_text(size=8,angle=90))
